# Full vs WM 1/4 vs WM 1/8 vs WM OFF (auto-generated by tools/compare_freq.py)

Quadruped Walk, base run seed 1, branch seed 7, +20k frames per arm (2500 actor-critic updates; only the number of WM gradient steps differs). Eval = 10 episodes, mean action, no guidance. AUC = trapezoid over (initial, +10k, +20k) / 20k frames. Loss = arm − Full mean. **1 seed: descriptive only.**

Extra Full replicate: the base run's own continuation from the same 20k state (original update, base-run RNG), evaluated at 40k with the same protocol (eval_s40) = 580. Full at +20k then spans 580–707; loss vs their mean (644): Every4 -133, OFF -92. (No +10k eval with this protocol, so not in AUC.)
